name: Steven C. Rauchberg
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in New York, New York

about: The principal attorney at Steven C. Rauchberg, P.C., in New York, New York State, Steven C. Rauchberg is renowned for his vigorous pursuit of justice and his ability to acquire equitable compensation for those who have been injured. He has a proven track record in litigating intricate personal injury claims across legal forums, including state and federal courts. His proficiency encompasses an array of areas, including, but not limited to:

In his illustrious career, Mr. Rauchberg has made significant contributions to legal precedents by arguing critical issues before the New York State Appellate Division and the New York State Court of Appeals. In addition to his legal practice, he has represented notable recording artists in legal disputes and has also managed the careers of professional boxers while an executive at a sports management company.

After earning a B.S. in accounting from the University of Florida, Mr. Rauchberg pursued his legal studies at the New York Law School, where he graduated cum laude. He is licensed to practice law in New York and New Jersey. Furthermore, he has been admitted to the United States District Courts for the Southern and Eastern Districts of New York, the Supreme Court of the United States and the United States Court of Appeals for the 6th Circuit.

Mr. Rauchberg has previously sat on the Automobile Litigation Committee of the New York State Trial Lawyers Association and the New York State Bar Association. Committed to community service, he has actively supported families within Brooklyn's Bedford-Stuyvesant neighborhood as a Bed-Stuy Advocates Advisory Counsel Committee member. Additionally, he holds a membership in the prestigious Mensa International.
